opening.argument: The presentation states its purpose plainly: teaching staff to use Microsoft Teams for remote learning and teaching. It then explains how to schedule meetings, communicate with students, add assignments, and view student work through the grades tab. Those are ordinary classroom workflows, consistent with the classroom teams, e-safety presentation, and assignment and grading views. The request to like and subscribe is ordinary audience engagement; it is not tied to payment, investment, credential submission, or another financial offer. The observable content supports an instructional purpose.

citations.quote: Today, we're going to be looking at how we can use. Microsoft Teams for remote learning and teaching.
And then how we can use this to schedule meetings,. Communicate with students,. Add assignments, and that kind of thing.
Another option in Teams is the assignments and this allows you to submit tasks to students so. They can complete it.
Once set up you will also have a grades tab where you can view the. Students work.
